chunks.content: Automated infrastructure with Terraform (IaC) and rolled out changes via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Operated a K8s cluster of 40 nodes and set up mTLS between services using an internal PKI.
Wrote gRPC APIs for internal service-to-service calls with Protocol Buffers schemas.
Ran a knitting circle at the local library on weekends.
Implemented OAuth 2.1 + PKCE for a customer-facing SPA and hardened SAML SSO for the admin console.

query: Platform engineer with K8s cluster operations, mTLS enforcement, and PKI certificate management.
notes: Chunks 0, 1, 4 each match at least two acronyms in the original query intent (Terraform+CI/CD, K8s, OAuth). Chunk 2 is technical adjacent (gRPC) but not what the query asks. Chunk 3 is a distractor. Acronyms tend to hit the keyword arm cleanly; vector arm may struggle with abbreviations. QUERY REDESIGN (v1.2.M2): 'K8s mTLS PKI cluster' targets chunk 1 specifically — plainto_tsquery produces 'k8s' & 'mtls' & 'pki' & 'cluster', all four of which appear in chunk 1. Chunks 0 and 4 lack these exact tokens, so they can only be surfaced by the vector arm. This demonstrates that acronym-dense queries can hit keyword precisely for one chunk while vector handles the rest. Keyword-arm expected hit: chunk 1 only.
